title: 山神庭院物种百科不定时更新森林守卫 合集及相关能力介绍
content_zh:
，，！
煤球怪（任意）产地：全职猎人简介：喜欢躲藏在阴暗的角落里，喜欢吃灰尘。
高山冷泉（半山腰）产地：轮回乐园简介：蕴藏在山脉中的冷泉，泡澡可加快体力恢复。
卷叶树产地：全职猎人简介：口感形似生菜和莴苣的结合体，高纤维，高饱腹感。
白腹大甲虫（林地）产地：全职猎人能力：指挥普通昆虫，并分泌生物霉。
简介：属性在10~13点，长期栖息在卷叶树上。
泡泡马（草原）产地：全职猎人简介：洁白的马身，彩色的马尾，喷射出的泡泡，破裂后有着空气弹的冲击力。
银犬（矿区、山地）产地：全职猎人简介：小型约克郡犬，在食用100克黄金后，可产出银粪便。
珍珠蝗虫（沼泽地，草原）产地：全职猎人简介：喜欢食用卷叶，可产出15以上的珍珠。
巨型蜥蜴（沼泽）产地：全职猎人简介：大型蜥蜴，懒，喜欢藏在阴凉处，产蛋量惊人。
迷魂蝶产地：全职猎人（沼泽地）简介：群居虫类，蝶翅科，可以催眠净胜强度低于5的生物。
饮血蝶（林地、草原）产地：全职猎人简介：群居，蝶翅科，喜欢吸食血液，对血液纪委铭感，可在3公里之内察觉到流血目标。
露营虎产地：全职猎人。
（林地核心、溪谷）简介：全属性在30~40左右，虎王属性55左右，能够使用简单的工具。
狐熊（沼泽地、林地）产地：全职猎人简介：家庭式族群，领地意识强。
豪鼻野猪（林地、沼泽地、溪谷）产地：全职猎人简介：群居，皮厚，繁殖力强，肉美。
加鲁加大产地：全职猎人（河流）简介：群居，肉鲜美，大型鱼类，繁殖力强。
千年凤蝶（天空）产地：全职猎人简介：珍兽，洒落的鳞粉具有‘丰产’的能力，属性30~45波动。
水晶鳩（溪谷、山顶）产地：全职猎人简介：族群鸟类，可产出具有剧毒的‘水晶羽毛’透明水母（精灵树树冠）产地：全职猎人简介：具有‘空间’属性的念兽，可产出‘念兽的卵’，生育率低下。
念力鼠（地下、山洞）产地：全职猎人简介：族群，具有微弱的念能（操控系），但极其胆小。

掌上人鱼（湖泊）产地：全职猎人简介：迷你版小人鱼，咏唱的讴歌，可以舒缓精神力，并提升少量精神韧性。
变色龙猫（山地）产地：全职猎人简介：米白色的龙猫，可以变形成其他物种，仅有一只。
精灵树产地：七大罪简介：蕴含生命气息，逐步改善地理环境，并增加最大10公里内，所有动植物的生长速度、结果率、成长品质，以及生命恢复速度。
蓝晶血蝶（林地、天空）产地：轮回乐园（基因融合产物）能力：统治‘血晶蝶’‘迷魂蝶’。
简介：产出拥有止血效果的晶蓝鳞粉，评分1点材料（100克）。

Coal Ball Monster (any) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: Likes to hide in dark corners and eat dust.
Alpine Cold Spring (midway up the mountain) Origin: Samsara Paradise Introduction: A cold spring hidden in the mountains. Taking a bath can speed up physical recovery.
Roll-leaf tree Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: The taste is like a combination of lettuce and lettuce, high in fiber and high in satiety.
White-bellied Giant Beetle (Woodland) Origin: Full-time Hunter Ability: Command ordinary insects and secrete biological mold.
Introduction: Attributes range from 10 to 13 points, and it has long lived on a roll-leaf tree.
Bubble Horse (Prairie) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: White horse body, colorful pony tail, ejected bubbles, with the impact of air bombs after bursting.
Silver Dog (Mining Area, Mountain Area) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: A small Yorkshire dog that can produce silver feces after eating 100 grams of gold.
Pearl Locust (swamp, grassland) Origin: Full-time hunter Introduction: Likes to eat rolled leaves and can produce more than 15 pearls.
Giant Lizard (Swamp) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: Large lizard, lazy, likes to hide in the shade, and lays an amazing amount of eggs.
Origin of the Ecstasy Butterfly: Full-time Hunter (Swampland) Introduction: A social insect from the family Spheniidae, which can hypnotize creatures with a net win strength of less than 5.
Blood-drinking butterfly (woodland, grassland) Origin: Full-time hunter Introduction: Lives in groups, family Butterfly, likes to suck blood, has a keen sense of blood discipline, and can detect bleeding targets within 3 kilometers.
Camping Tiger Origin: Full-time hunter.
(Woodland Core, Valley) Introduction: All attributes are around 30~40, Tiger King attribute is around 55, and can use simple tools.
Fox Bear (swampland, woodland) Origin: Full-time hunter Introduction: Family-oriented group with strong territorial awareness.
Pole-nosed wild boar (woodland, swamp, valley) Origin: Full-time hunter Introduction: Lives in groups, has thick skin, strong reproductive capacity, and beautiful meat.
Garuga's main origin: Full-time hunter (river) Introduction: Lives in groups, has delicious meat, large fish, and strong reproductive capacity.
Millennium Papilio Butterfly (Sky) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: A rare beast, the scale powder scattered has the ability of ‘high yield’, and the attributes fluctuate from 30 to 45.
Crystal Dove (Valley, Mountain Top) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: A group of birds that can produce highly toxic 'crystal feathers' transparent jellyfish (Elf Tree Crown) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: A mind beast with the 'space' attribute, which can produce 'mind beast eggs', with a low fertility rate.
Telekinesis rats (underground, caves) Origin: full-time hunter Introduction: ethnic group, with weak telekinesis (control system), but extremely timid.
Palm Mermaid (Lake) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: A mini version of the little mermaid, singing a hymn that can soothe the spirit and improve a small amount of mental toughness.
Chameleon Chinchilla (Mountain) Origin: Full-time Hunter Introduction: An off-white chinchilla that can transform into other species, there is only one.
Elf Tree Origin: Seven Deadly Sins Introduction: Contains the breath of life, gradually improves the geographical environment, and increases the growth speed, fruiting rate, growth quality, and life recovery speed of all animals and plants within a maximum of 10 kilometers.
Blue Crystal Blood Butterfly (woodland, sky) Origin: Samsara Paradise (product of gene fusion) Ability: Dominate the 'Blood Crystal Butterfly' and 'Ecstasy Butterfly'.
Introduction: Produces crystal blue scale powder with hemostatic effect, scoring 1 point of material (100g).
